```js
function normPriority(p) {
  return String(p ?? "").trim().toUpperCase()
}

function priorityCorrect(got, want) {
  return normPriority(got) !== "" && normPriority(got) === normPriority(want)
}

// selftest additions

assert(priorityCorrect(" P1 ", "P1") === true)

```
